items.author: ByeongkiJeong
items.body:
I've observed an issue when using Azure OpenAI, where the documented endpoint structure typically includes the deployment name:

- `https://{aoai_resource_name}.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/{deployment_name}/chat/completions?api-version={api_version}`

However, within the **OpenCode** implementation, it appears the `deployments/{deployment_name}` segment is being omitted. This leads to API calls being directed to:

- `https://{aoai_resource_name}.openai.azure.com/openai/chat/completions?api-version={api_version}`

This discrepancy directly results in **HTTP 404 (Not Found) errors**, as
items.title: Azure OpenAI API Call Issue: Missing Deployment Name in OpenCode Requests (404 Error)
